title: Python Functions
summary: Learn how to define and use functions in Python to organize reusable code.
common_mistakes: Using a function before defining it
practice_idea: Write a function that takes two numbers and returns their sum.

title: Python Lists
summary: Learn how to store and manipulate ordered collections of values using lists.
common_mistakes: Using an index outside the list range
Modifying a list while iterating over it
practice_idea: Create a list of numbers and write a function that returns only the even numbers.

title: Python Dictionaries
summary: Learn how to store data as key-value pairs using Python dictionaries.
common_mistakes: Using a key that does not exist
Trying to access a dictionary value with an index
practice_idea: Create a dictionary that stores the names and ages of three people, then display each person.

title: Python Decorators
summary: Learn how decorators modify or extend the behavior of functions without changing their code.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to return the wrapper function
Forgetting to call the original function inside the wrapper
Using a decorator before understanding nested functions
practice_idea: Create a decorator that prints a message before and after a function call.

title: C Pointers
summary: Learn how pointers store memory addresses and how they are used to access and modify data in C.
common_mistakes: Confusing a pointer with the value it points to
Forgetting to initialize a pointer before using it
practice_idea: Write a C function that swaps the values of two integers using pointers.
